decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE event specifying that the 2nd and 3rd takes must both be edited; the delivery modification adds no missing post-production state.
Selecting the 2nd and 3rd takes for editing and separate delivery does not change the established energy, liveliness, tone, pride, or overacting constraints.
The request to edit and separately deliver the 2nd and 3rd takes does not alter the existing smooth-pacing requirement for the final sentence.
